_comment: Editorial content for GRR. This is a REIT scheme, not an operating company: it is a trust managed by a licensed REIT Management Company, so the fields below describe the scheme and its manager. It has no products of its own. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached.
description: Globe Residency REIT (GRR) is a closed-end, limited-life developmental REIT scheme established by a trust deed dated 24 December 2021 between Arif Habib Dolmen REIT Management Limited, as the REIT Management Company, and the Central Depository Company of Pakistan Limited, as trustee. It is dedicated to constructing and selling Globe Residency Apartments — 1,344 apartments across nine towers on FL sites covering about 40,500 square yards in the vicinity of Naya Nazimabad, Karachi — and the project was transferred from Javedan Corporation Limited on 1 April 2022. It listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange on 28 December 2022 as Pakistan's first developmental REIT scheme. Three of the nine towers are developed under a 50/50 Musharaka with Meezan Bank Limited.
headOffice: Arif Habib Centre, 23 M.T. Khan Road, Karachi, Pakistan
